notablePrerequisites: You control at least one other Orc and/or Shaman.
description:
Cast Electrodominance by paying {3}{R}{R}.
Holding priority, activate Rootha by paying {2} and returning it to your hand, copying Electrodominance.
Resolve the copy of Electrodominance, dealing 3 damage to any target and casting Rootha without paying its mana cost.
Rootha enters the battlefield, triggering Mana Echoes, adding at least {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.
If you control two other Orcs and/or Shamans, this combo nets infinite colorless mana.
